entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Severe and unbending, the coldness hardened into a settled refusal of cordiality rather than the passing chill of *frosty*.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The lightest chill of the group, a manner cooled and capable of thawing, not the fixed disdain of *glacial*.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coldness as arrest: cordiality not merely withheld but stopped dead, the unfriendliness locked in place.
examples: a frozen look on their faces

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heaviest cold here, vast and immovable, a disdain that takes no trouble to hide itself.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Cold with an edge on it, the chill pointed at someone and meant to cut, where *wintry* only surrounds them.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Bleak rather than sharp, an unwelcoming climate about the person instead of the single stroke of *icy*.

entries.definition: marked by great psychological weight; weighted down especially with sadness or troubles or weariness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest name for the condition itself, sadness or trouble felt as weight from inside, where *burdensome* describes the load from outside.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the difficulty in the thing rather than the bearer: a load fixed on you that has to be carried, not merely a strain that tires.
examples: the burdensome task of preparing the income tax return

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal member, and the heaviest-sounding of the three, where *taxing* keeps the same complaint everyday.
examples: my duties weren't onerous: I only had to greet the guests

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Leans on the wearing half of the sense, draining strength steadily rather than crushing, the lightest of the three.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain, full-strength member of the group, naming real hurt and not merely unease.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The stiffer, more formal shape of *distressing*, with the same weight of hurt behind it.
examples: lived in heroic if something distressful isolation

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Aimed at composure rather than comfort, it unsettles and goes on unsettling, where *distressing* simply hurts.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest and most formal here, ruffling the mind where *disturbing* unseats it.
examples: a revelation that was most perturbing

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Quiet and persistent, a worry that nags at you instead of striking, understated beside *distressing*.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Treats the power to cause anxiety as a standing property of the thing, where *worrying* reports what it is doing now.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Keeps to the worry-and-anxiety end of the sense, unease rather than the hurt *distressing* names.

entries.definition: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most physical word in the family, heaviness and weariness fused into dead metal, dull and unliftable.
